title: Relation Inference
description: The derived finding that a candidate observer is, or is not, independent of a run. Independence is inferred from the run's own record and is never declared by the observer: a declared relation would be the observer vouching for itself, which is the same substitution as an executor's report standing in for an observation. The inference walks a closed set of direct edges. One edge found is DIRECT. None found, over a complete record, is INDEPENDENT. A record too thin to answer is UNDETERMINED and refuses, because absence of a recorded edge is not absence of a relation.

candidate_observer_id.description: The actor proposed as observer. Proposing is not declaring independence.

executor_id.description: The actor the run's record attributes the execution to, read from that record rather than supplied by the candidate.

edges_examined.description: Every direct edge this inference looked for. The set is closed: an edge outside it cannot be examined, and a candidate connected by an unlisted route reads as independent. That is the enforcement surface of the whole service.

edges_found.description: The examined edges that held. Non-empty means DIRECT.

record_completeness.description: Whether the run's record carried enough to answer every examined edge. INCOMPLETE forces UNDETERMINED; it never reads as independence.

unanswerable_edges.description: Edges the record could not answer. Required to be non-empty when record_completeness is INCOMPLETE, so an incomplete verdict names what it could not see.

evidence_addresses.description: What the inference read to reach its finding. An inference that read nothing has not inferred.

record_digest.description: sha256 over the entry digests of the whole record the inference was read over, in append order. observe_run recomputes it from the record it is handed and refuses RELATION_UNDETERMINED when they differ, so an inference cannot be carried onto a substituted record, well formed or not.

edge.description: A direct relation between a candidate observer and a run.

evidence_address.description: Where in the run's record this edge was seen. A found edge with no address is an assertion, not a finding.

oneOf.description: DIRECT: at least one edge held. The candidate may not observe this run.
INDEPENDENT: no edge held and the record answered every one of them.
UNDETERMINED: the record could not answer. Refuses; never reads as independence.
